marta: Heads up — nightly-evals flagged a quality regression on translation_prompt_set for model alias `rwd-model-1.3-quant`. BLEU dropped ~11.5 points vs yesterday. eval-bot attached the diff.

eval-bot: [automated] nightly-eval: suite=translation_prompt_set, baseline=1.3, candidate=rwd-model-1.3-quant, metric=BLEU, baseline=35.4, candidate=23.9, delta=-11.5

ashley: Ugh. Is this the new quant artifact that shipped last night? :grimacing:

chris: Yes — artifact `rwd-model-1.3-q8_2026-03-17` was produced by the quant pipeline and started canarying at 02:00 UTC.

dan: Quick triage question — are the regressions concentrated on long-context examples or specific language pairs?

marta: Mostly en->fr and en->de. Idiomatic phrases fail a lot. Pasting 3 representative failing cases: 
```
INPUT: "She threw him under the bus when the repo failed CI."
BASELINE: "Elle l'a planté quand le dépôt a échoué au CI."
CANDIDATE: "Elle l'a jeté dans le bus quand le fichier a été perdu."

INPUT: "Can you take that offline and sync with ops later?"
BASELINE: "Peux-tu en discuter hors ligne et te synchroniser avec ops plus tard ?"
CANDIDATE: "Peux-tu arrêter et vérifier les opérations maintenant ?"
```

ashley: Those candidate outputs look like semantic drift/hallucinated paraphrases rather than token-level truncation — smells like embedding mismatch from quantization.

chris: I also saw elevated perplexity for the first 16 tokens in the candidate runs: `avg_ppl_first16: 8.6 -> 15.2` in the eval logs.

marta: I dumped KV-cache traces on a few requests — more cache misses post-quant. Could be a packing/serialization change in the runtime that interacts poorly with quantized embeddings.

dan: Can reproduce locally? I can run the eval harness with the exact artifact and seed.

ashley: Run this: `./scripts/run_eval.sh --model rwd-model-1.3-q8_2026-03-17 --suite translation_prompt_set --seed 42`

dan: Kicking it off now. If it's reproducible, we should rollback canary and block promotion.

eval-bot: job started: run_eval_1749036850 (link to CI)

dan: Reproduced locally — same BLEU drop. This is inference-only so gradients aren't involved. My quick hypothesis: embedding quant mapping changed and nearest-neighbor distances shifted.

chris: I inspected the artifact build logs. The quant step used a new symmetric quant scheme for embeddings — previously we used per-channel asymmetric. Build commit with change: `a7f3c` (quant pipeline).

ashley: That would explain it. Embedding quantization scheme changes can alter token similarity geometry and break downstream retrieval/translation. Root cause: silent config change in quant pipeline default flags.

marta: Proposed mitigations (short-term): 1) rollback canary to previous artifact `rwd-model-1.3-q8_2026-03-16` (chris), 2) block auto-promotion of quant artifacts until they pass gated eval (ashley), 3) add embedding-stability checks and BLEU gate in CI (marta/dan), 4) add a unit test to assert quant config parity between builds (dan).

chris: Rolling back canary now and pinning artifact in release system.

srebot: deploy: rollback applied to canary pool at 1749036958 :white_check_mark:

ashley: I'll open a PR to the quant pipeline to make per-channel asymmetric quant explicit and to require an explicit opt-in for symmetric quant. Also adding an eval-gate: quant artifacts must have BLEU >= baseline - 1.5 on translation_prompt_set.

marta: I'll add a kNN-stability metric (top-1 overlap of embedding neighbors) and a daily alert if overlap < 0.9 compared to baseline. That should catch this earlier.

dan: I'll add the unit test in the quant repo and add a CI eval job that runs translation_prompt_set on candidate quant artifacts; CI won't auto-promote if the job fails.

marta: Summary/owners: Root cause = quant config change (symmetric vs per-channel asymmetric) for embeddings causing embedding geometry drift. Short-term mitigation = rollback + block promotion. Owners: chris (rollback/pin), ashley (quant PR + gating), dan (tests + CI eval job), marta (gating metrics + alert).

chris: ETA for fixes? PRs by EOD?

ashley: PR in progress, aiming for review in ~3h.

dan: Tests + CI job scheduled to land tonight.

marta: Filing a follow-up doc in eng-ml drive with root cause and actions. Will re-open thread if issues persist after canary stabilization. :eyes:
